issues.title: Your text is too hard to read
issues.desc: Text and background colors do not have enough contrast for people with low vision.

issues.title: Maps and widgets are invisible
issues.desc: Embedded maps or widgets have no title, so screen readers skip them entirely.

issues.title: Links blend into text
issues.desc: Links inside paragraphs are only distinguished by color, which is invisible to colorblind users.

issues.title: Screen reader markup is broken
issues.desc: ARIA parent elements are missing required child elements.

issues.title: Mystery links with no name
issues.desc: Links have no descriptive text, so screen readers just say "link" with no context.

issues.title: Navigation is broken
issues.desc: The page has no main content landmark, so screen reader users cannot jump directly to the content.
